title: Phlo Event Source
description: Canonical representation of the system/producer an event originated from.

producer.description: Producer identifier, e.g. dagster, dbt, trino, or the application name for first-party events.

raw_ref.description: Reference to the preserved raw payload, e.g. raw://<id>.

adapter.description: Adapter that normalized this event, e.g. dagster.v1.

ingested_at.description: UTC RFC3339 time the observer ingested the source payload.
